title: invoice
description: Fields extracted from an invoice. Consumed by the Extract and Validate states of the intake state machine; the extraction prompt is generated from this schema, so adding a field here is the only change needed to extract it.

invoice_number.description: Vendor's own identifier for this invoice.

total_amount.description: Grand total including tax, in the currency given by `currency`.

vendor_name.description: Legal name of the issuing party.

purchase_order.description: Buyer's PO reference, when the invoice quotes one.
